subtitle: Pointing an external stage at a bucket you already own

caption: The same Create Stage dialog, filled in with a real S3 bucket and path.

annotations.label: The exact prefix — trailing slash included

eyebrow: The other end of the load
caption: Whatever bucket you point at, the target table's columns still have to line up.
Role and warehouse are set here — get this wrong and the load never starts.

code:
CREATE OR REPLACE STORAGE INTEGRATION s3_int
  TYPE = EXTERNAL_STAGE
  STORAGE_PROVIDER = 'S3'
  ENABLED = TRUE
  STORAGE_AWS_ROLE_ARN = 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/snowflake_role'
  STORAGE_ALLOWED_LOCATIONS = ('s3://my-bucket/data/');
caption: Snowflake assumes your IAM role instead of storing secret keys.
